note.question: How do prepositioning and local purchasing interact for emergency operations under budget, demand, and supply uncertainty?
note.overview: Considering a mix of prepositioning and local purchasing, common to cover humanitarian demands in the aftermath of a rapid-onset disaster, we propose policies to determine preposition stock. These formulations are developed in the presence of demand, budget, and local supply uncertainties and for single-items delivery. The immediate period aftermath of a disaster is the most crucial period during which humanitarian organizations must supply relief items to beneficiaries.
